title: Truchas 2D thermal sources
description: A named collection of volumetric thermal sources. A source may be read from a cell data file and scaled by a scalar function, or defined by a scalar function on selected cell sets.

cell-set-ids.description: One or more mesh cell-set identifiers to which the source applies.

data-file.description: File containing the cell-based source data.

prefactor.description: Scalar prefactor applied to the data-file source.

source.description: Volumetric source rate as a constant or inline scalar function.
